text:
devon: Heads up — PR #2451 is ready but CI is lagging for APAC runners and there's a deploy blackout window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. Can we coordinate a staggered merge + canary to avoid hitting the blackout?

maria: ETA on CI green? I can hold approvals until we confirm the canary window.

ci-bot: PR #2451 — checks: unit-tests (running), e2e (queued on apac-runner), lint (passed) — queued: 3 jobs.

sam: I saw flaky e2e on apac yesterday. I pushed a small timeout fix in the test harness at 11:12 PT. Needs a rebase.

devon: OK rebase required — @sam can you `git rebase origin/main` and force-push? quick snippet: `git fetch && git rebase origin/main && git push --force-with-lease`

sam: done, pushed at 11:20 PT. CI retriggering.

ci-bot: PR #2451 — unit-tests: passed; e2e: running (apac-runner); integration: queued.

lina: If tests pass, I'm happy to do the canary deploy (small % traffic) at 12:30 PT, then full merge at 13:00 PT if no regressions. That avoids the blackout.

ops-oncall: Confirming blackout is 02:00-04:00 UTC (maintenance). Canary before 18:00 UTC is fine. Please avoid any cross-region DB migration during canary.

ash: I can approve after green + a quick smoke test. Will watch the canary logs.

maria: Let's gate merge on: 1) all CI checks green, 2) canary logs OK for 15m, 3) no DB migration. I'll queue approval once criteria met.

devon: Sounds good. @ci-bot ping back when all checks green. We'll coordinate approvals in this thread.

ci-bot: PR #2451 — all checks: passed. Report: unit-tests (ok), e2e (ok), integration (ok). Artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/pr-2451/ci-4620001234

lina: Starting canary rollout at 12:31 PT -> 10% traffic. Watching errors and latency.

ash: smoke tests running against canary endpoint — no obvious errors so far. :thumbsup:

maria: 15m in, metrics stable. Approving now. :white_check_mark:

devon: merging now. Thanks @lina @ash @maria. Will monitor.

ci-bot: Merge action succeeded. PR #2451 merged to main by devon at 12:47 PT. Canary complete, promoting to 100%.

lina: Post-merge note: no DB migrations, rollout completed without spikes. Closing out. :tada:
